item.title: 1. Context of the Organization and Leadership
item.description:
1. Overview

ISO/IEC 42001 §4 and §5 are the foundation of the AI management system. They determine which AI systems the organization operates, who the interested parties are, and on what principles top management will manage AI.

From the perspective of open source practitioners, §5.2 (AI policy) is the most important point of intersection. Including principles on open source use in the AI policy makes it possible to operate it in an integrated way with the ISO 5230 policy.
